title: apply input
description: One batch of operations on one Space. The batch is atomic: all ops apply or none do, and it is one revert unit.

oneOf.title: add text
oneOf.description: Add a text: Plain text or Markdown.

oneOf.title: add note
oneOf.description: Add a note: A sticky note.

oneOf.title: add math
oneOf.description: Add a math: LaTeX math, rendered natively.

oneOf.title: add shape
oneOf.description: Add a shape: A shape with optional text inside it.

oneOf.title: add connector
oneOf.description: Add a connector: A line or arrow. Bind both ends to Elements with from and to, and it follows them when they move. Or give points for a free line, such as an underline.

oneOf.title: add image
oneOf.description: Add a image: A picture. Photos and PDF pages the person adds become images they can write on.

oneOf.title: add frame
oneOf.description: Add a frame: A titled container. Elements placed inside it move with it.

oneOf.title: add region
oneOf.description: Add a region: An area with its own rules: whether Ink is allowed, whether Agents may write there, watch mode, and a Send button scoped to it.

oneOf.title: add embed
oneOf.description: Add a embed: Web or 3D content Reflex does not natively understand, sandboxed. Use one of: template (an Embed Template, with params), html (inline HTML), url (an MCP App 'ui://' resource or an https page), or model (a USDZ or glTF asset).

oneOf.title: add extension
oneOf.description: Add an Element of an extension type. Its fields go in props. If props fail the type's schema, the error includes a schema excerpt and one example. Call read_me(type) first.

oneOf.title: patch
oneOf.description: Change one of your Elements with explicit field operations. Each key is one operation; use as many as you need. Their merge behavior with concurrent edits is defined, so prefer text_insert over setting the whole text.

set.description: Fields to set to new values.

unset.description: Fields to clear back to their defaults.

text_insert.description: Insert text at a UTF-16 offset.

text_delete.description: Delete len UTF-16 code units starting at at.

map_put.description: Set one key inside data, props or params, leaving the other keys alone.

oneOf.title: remove
oneOf.description: Remove your Elements. A person's Ink can never be removed.

oneOf.title: arrange
oneOf.description: Lay out Elements and let Reflex compute the positions. tree follows the connectors between them.

at.description: Where the arranged group goes. Defaults to where the first Element is.

oneOf.title: focus
oneOf.description: Point your own view, the one look renders by default, at Elements or bounds. It never moves the person's screen; to ask for their attention, use request_attention.

oneOf.title: define recipe
oneOf.description: Save a Recipe to the person's Library, where every Agent finds it in read_me('index') and applies it with recipe(name, params). template is a list of apply ops. A string value that is exactly '{{name}}' is replaced by that parameter's value, keeping its type; '{{name}}' inside a longer string is replaced by its text.

params.description: A JSON Schema (the same restricted subset) for the parameters, not their values.

oneOf.title: define embed
oneOf.description: Save an Embed Template to the person's Library, so any Agent can add it with add embed {template: name, params}. template is one HTML file; it talks to Reflex only through the reflex bridge (reflex.element.props(), state(), setState(), notify(), emit(), panel.open(), anchors.register()).

params.description: A JSON Schema (the same restricted subset) for the parameters, not their values.

source.description: For an MCP App view: the 'ui://' resource template was read from. Its calls to that server's tools are denied, with a note on the Embed, unless the person allows the server; then they reach you as a tap.

in_reply_to.description: The Send this batch answers. Passing it acknowledges that Send.

look.description: When true, the result also carries a rendered crop of what changed.

agents_read_only.description: When true, no Agent may write inside this Region. Default false.

allow.description: Extra network hosts this Embed may reach, on top of the person's allowlist.

behavior.description: What happens when someone interacts with an Element: one trigger (on) paired with one action (do). An Element can have several. Fields beyond on and do belong to the trigger or action named: event for embed_event; panel for open_panel; payload for notify and send; target and set for set; recipe and params for apply_recipe.

event.description: embed_event only: the event name the Embed emits with reflex.emit(name, payload).

payload.description: notify and send: JSON passed to the Agent with the tap or Send.

target.description: set only: the Element to change. Defaults to this Element.

set.description: set only: fields to set on the target, as in patch.set.

behaviors.description: Trigger-action pairs, run when someone interacts with this Element.

bounds.description: [x, y, width, height] in the reading Agent's coordinates. x and y are the top-left corner.

common_color.description: A named color. Reflex picks the exact shade for light and dark mode.

common_data.description: A free JSON map the Agent defines, such as a task ID, a test case or a score. Reflex stores, syncs and returns it but never interprets it. At most 16 KiB of JSON per Element. Patch it with map_put and map_delete.

common_snap.description: Snap rules for a draggable Element: to a grid, or to the given Elements.

connector_text.description: A label drawn on the line.

coord.description: One coordinate in the reading Agent's own integer coordinate space for this Space. Its origin never moves (ADR-0007).

count.description: A non-negative integer in the shared safe range.

draggable.description: Whether the person can drag it. Default false for Agent Elements.

element_id.description: A short ID the Agent chose, such as 'n-auth'. IDs are scoped to the Agent that made them, so two Agents never collide. Reflex-made IDs (Ink, user imports, generated) use the same alphabet.

from.description: The Element or Mark the line starts at.

h.description: Height. Reflex sizes it to fit its content when unset.

ink.description: Whether the person may draw Ink here. Default true.

length.description: A width, height or gap in the same units as coord.

locked.description: When true, the person can't move, resize or delete it.

model.description: A 3D model: an https URL or 'asset:<sha256>' of a USDZ or glTF file.

new_id.description: Your ID for it. Reflex generates one when unset and reports it in the result's ids.

page.description: For a PDF page: its 1-based page number.

panel.description: Native interface Reflex renders from JSON, such as a detail sidebar or a form. Values the person enters fire panel_change Behaviors and appear in the next Send's changes.

panel_component.description: One Panel component. kind picks which other fields apply: text and markdown use text; button uses label and do; choice uses label, options, value and multiple; text_field uses label and value; number and slider use label, value, min, max and step; toggle uses label and value; embed uses template and params, or html, plus h.

id.description: Names this component's value in panel changes. Required for components that take input.

do.description: button only: send ends the person's turn with a Send; notify tells the Agent without ending it.

template.description: embed only: an Embed Template's name.

html.description: embed only: inline HTML, sandboxed like any Embed.

params.description: Parameter values for a Recipe or an Embed Template, checked against that Recipe's or Template's own parameter schema.

placement.description: Where to put something. Prefer a relation to an Element or a Mark and let Reflex compute the geometry: set exactly one of right_of, left_of, above, below, near or inside, plus an optional gap. Or set x and y for an absolute top-left corner in your own coordinates.

point.description: [x, y] in the reading Agent's coordinates.

points.description: A free polyline in your coordinates, used when from and to are not set.

request_id.description: An idempotency key chosen by the caller. A retry with the same key and the same payload returns the first result; with a different payload it is rejected (request_reused).

send_button.description: The label of a Send button scoped to this Region, such as 'Check my work'. Unset means no button.

set_data.description: Replace the whole data map. To change one key, use map_put.

set_props.description: Extension types only: replace these props.

space_name.description: A Space's short, stable name, such as 'auth-plan'.

src.description: An https URL, or an asset reference 'asset:<sha256>'.

target_ref.description: An Element ID or a Mark ID from a Send Bundle.

text.description: The text. With markdown: true it is rendered as Markdown.

to.description: The Element or Mark the line ends at.

w.description: Width. Reflex sizes it to fit its content when unset.

watch.description: When true, debounced snapshots of this Region reach its Agent as Send Bundles with kind 'watch'. Default false.
